title: FBI Photo B22
doc_notes: This document is an FBI submission to AARO containing a single still image of a UAP event with a known incorrect timestamp.

incidents.summary: Two small, dark, elongated objects observed in a grainy monochrome image captured by a U.S. military system.
incidents.explanation: The operator reported that they were unable to positively identify the UAP.
incidents.quote: Two small, dark, elongated objects are visible near the center of the frame
